# FRAMEXGOD

> Miami video production studio: music videos, commercials, brand films and monthly brand content on ARRI cinema cameras. Markets: Miami, New York, Los Angeles. 750M+ views on directed music videos. Phone 305 778 5526. Email Info@FramexGod.com. Website https://framexgod.com

## What we do
- Music videos from $3,500 (one-day shoot; concept, direction, cinematography, edit, color; master + 3 vertical cuts)
- Commercials from $7,500 (treatment, crew, casting, locations, licensed music; 60/30/15/6-second cuts)
- Content days from $1,500 (8–10 vertical pieces, delivered in 48 hours)
- Monthly brand retainers: Launch $4,500/mo, Growth $8,500/mo, Flagship $15,000/mo — brand identity + logo, website built and hosted, monthly ARRI shoot (reels, stills, brand film), graphics + AI creative design, posting + paid ads, conversions + monthly reporting

## Gear
ARRI ALEXA, Cooke anamorphic lenses, ARRI SkyPanel + M-Series lighting, techno-crane, FPV and cinema drones, underwater housing. Feature-film color grade in DaVinci Resolve.

## Credits
Sony Music, Epic, Interscope, Maybach Music Group, Universal France; Carnival, Baptist Health, GM. 105°F Remix (750M+ views), Stay Schemin, Hard Drive, BEBE. Feature film Merlin (2025), People's Choice Award, Chandler Film Festival.
